trends.name: U.S.-Iran Escalation & War Risk Premium
trends.summary: Trump issued 48-hour ultimatum to Iran amid missing U.S. service member rescue mission, triggering immediate geopolitical risk pricing into energy and defense sectors. Real-time betting markets (Polymarket) removing Iran wagers signals elevated uncertainty. U.S. businesses already pricing in conflict-related supply chain and cost pressures.

trends.name: Energy Sector Surge On Rising Oil Prices
trends.summary: Rising energy prices benefiting oil & gas plays (GNR, FET) but exposing fragility in logistics (UPS profitability margins thin despite higher rates). Iran tensions amplifying crude rally. Midstream assets (Hess Midstream) positioned to reap rewards but macro headwinds present downside risks.

trends.name: Fed Policy Uncertainty & Warsh Nomination
trends.summary: Trump's Fed chair nominee Warsh advancing through confirmation, setting up competing monetary policy plans on collision course with existing Fed leadership. Markets pricing divergence between hawkish Trump administration and dovish central bank trajectory. Critical for rate expectations and bond yields.

trends.name: AI Infrastructure & Semiconductor Opportunity
trends.summary: Broadcom positioned as 'AI plumber' for massive infrastructure buildout with potential for explosive growth. Ongoing AI capex cycle in data centers continues driving semiconductor demand. Apple's delayed AI strategy signals window for competitors to capture market share.

trends.name: Tech Sector Labor Restructuring
trends.summary: Oracle executing mass layoffs via email signaling broader tech sector cost-cutting phase. OpenAI leadership changes (Fidji Simo medical leave) revealing internal challenges. Mass email layoffs becoming normalized operational practice, raising labor cost efficiency but offsetting wage pressures.

trends.name: High-Yield Dividend & Income Fund Demand
trends.summary: April 2026 dividend stock lists and tax-advantaged income funds from NEOS gaining traction as investors seek yield in rising-rate environment. Strong dividend focus suggests flight to income stability amid economic uncertainty and equity volatility concerns.

trends.name: Consumer Cost-of-Living Pressures Intensifying
trends.summary: Easter baskets shrinking (socks, leftover candy), Yankees games exceeding $1,200/year, basic airline fares stripped down—broad consumer discretionary deflation across entertainment, travel, and holidays. Inflation eroding purchasing power in traditionally resilient categories, signaling demand weakness ahead.

trends.name: Biotech Pipeline Advances & Kidney Disease Focus
trends.summary: Roivant (brepocitinib Phase III), Akebia (kidney disease pipeline), and Merck advancing therapies at key conferences. Multiple clinical catalysts emerging in nephrology and immunology spaces. Sector rotation toward specialized therapeutics with narrower but higher-value indications.

trends.name: Housing Market Buyer Leverage & Mortgage Dynamics
trends.summary: First time in years buyers have negotiating leverage in real estate. Inventory dynamics shifting as rising rates pressure sellers. Smart home-buying strategies emerging around seller concessions and price flexibility—signals potential mortgage origination recovery.

trends.name: Private Credit & Banking Sector Stability
trends.summary: Private credit 'growing pains' vs. crisis debate ongoing; Big Six banks (Huntington positioning preferred dividends) signaling safer alternative to direct private credit exposure. M&A activity strengthening bank balance sheets. Credit market stress fears contained but concentrated.

trends.name: Apple's AI Gap & Competitive Vulnerability
trends.summary: iPhone maker 'blew 5-year lead' on AI despite historical dominance, but former insiders claim recovery still possible. Apple's delayed AI strategy opening door for Broadcom, Nvidia, and other semiconductor players. Critical inflection point for Apple's services and ecosystem lock-in strategy.

trends.name: Market Volatility & April Seasonal Weakness Risk
trends.summary: April typically brings gains but 2026 showing no sure bet amid geopolitical tensions, inflation persistence, and policy uncertainty. Seasonal tailwinds unreliable; macro headwinds (energy costs, labor restructuring) offsetting traditional spring rally patterns. Risk-off positioning warranted.
